contacts.name: Medical Care
contacts.location: Building 1802- 1st Street Rota Naval Station Rota (CADIZ) Spain
contacts.notes: BEFORE ARRIVAL You and your family are required to undergo a medical screening upon receipt of our orders to transfer to an overseas location. The screening must be completed at your current MTF (Medical Treatment Facility). You can find additional information on this topic at mynavyhr.navy.mil. UPON ARRIVAL There is no on-base hospital or pharmacy, but the Medical Aid Station at Moron Air Base provides basic support to military members only. contacts.location: Bldg 106, E Avenue Moron AB Spain
contacts.notes: Mon-Fri 0800 - 1200 1300-1700 UPON ARRIVAL Furniture Loan The Morón Air Base Furnishings Management Section (FMS) is your contact for all loaner furniture matters during your assignment here in Spain. Military personnel and DoD civilian personnel authorized Overseas Housing Allowance or Living Quarters Allowance, and shipment of their household goods, are entitled to temporary loaner furniture. Loaner furniture support is authorized for a period of 90 days pending the arrival of your household goods.
